title: policy rule
description: A single ABAC rule within a Policy. Referenced by policy create/update request schemas and policy get/list/create/update response schemas.

id.description: Stable client-assigned rule identifier (scoped to the policy).

effect.$comment: enum: allow, deny — minLength/maxLength guards are length-based equivalents; add enum: [allow, deny] here if a future schema upgrade can break existing clients
effect.description: Authorization verdict. Valid values: allow, deny. Deny-overrides: any deny wins over all allows.

conditions.description: All conditions are AND-combined. Empty or absent means unconditional (rule always applies).

source.$comment: enum: subject, resource, environment — minLength/maxLength guards are length-based equivalents
source.description: Attribute namespace. Valid values: subject (principal claims), resource (protected object attrs), environment (context).

key.description: Attribute name within the source namespace (e.g. department, classification, time_of_day).

operator.$comment: enum: eq, neq, in, not_in — minLength/maxLength guards are length-based equivalents
operator.description: Comparison applied between the resolved attribute and values. Valid values: eq, neq, in, not_in.

values.description: Right-hand side of the comparison. Must be non-empty.

obligations.description: Obligations imposed on the PEP when this rule matches. All fields are optional.

rowScope.$comment: enum: self, device, tenant (all is wire-valid vocabulary but rejected by policy authoring — see description); minLength/maxLength guards are length-based equivalents and intentionally still admit 'all' so the server rejects it semantically (422), not structurally (400)
rowScope.description: Row-visibility obligation. Grantable values: self, device, tenant. The value 'all' (cross-tenant) is reserved for the audited super-admin derivation and is rejected with 422 when supplied via policy authoring. Absent means no row-scope constraint.

fieldMask.description: Fields the PEP must redact from the response. Absent or empty means no field-mask obligation.
